purpose: record where M1->M2 and L3 came from, so a later program cannot rediscover them as pristine findings

binding_rule.statement: M1->M2 and L3 may serve as a HYPOTHESIS SOURCE for future work. They may NOT enter a new confirmatory branch ON THE SAME HISTORY as though they had been pre-specified.
binding_rule.applies_to: the planned 1m -> 15m -> 1H -> 1D program and any successor
binding_rule.requirement: if either is carried forward, its provenance is carried with it and stated in the new branch's own registration
binding_rule.why: a hypothesis discovered in this history and then confirmed on this history is not confirmed; it is restated. Only a fresh evidence universe can test it.

outcome_exposure: NOT_EXPOSED — this artifact records provenance, not results
